name: Natural Treatment of Anorexia Nervosa

sections.herbal_remedies:
About Anorexia nervosa 
 This is an eating disorder that is characterized by weight loss. In this eating disorder, the person is having difficulty in maintaining proper weight. People with this disorder generally take a strict diet and excessive exercise.
sections.different_types_of_anorexia_nervosa:
Binge or purge type: In this type of anorexia, after eating food person will purge and this gives a birth to fear of gaining weight which results in excessive exercise by the person and also vomiting or abusing laxatives. 
 Restrictive type: In this type, the person is highly self disciplined. They follow a strict diet and exercise routine. This is also considered a form of self starvation.
sections.causes_of_anorexia_nervosa:
Genetic predisposition, personality traits and environmental factors are responsible for this particular disorder. 
 Influence of media 
 Professions such as modeling and ballet 
 Sexual abuse and severe trauma 
 Irregular hormone functioning 
 Genetics 

 This disorder begins at adolescence age. But this can also happen in older or teenage.
sections.signs_and_symptoms_of_anorexia_nervosa:
Refuse to eat certain food 
 Constipation, abdominal pain, cold intolerance, 
 Not feeling hungry often 
 Weight loss 
 Cooks meals for others without eating 
 Limited social spontaneity 
 Intense fear of weight gain 
 Shows flexible thinking
sections.follows_strict_diet_and_exercise_routine:
These are also some physical problems that a person suffers these include:

 Dry skin 
 Dry and brittle nails 
 Fine hair on body 
 Muscle weakness 
 Feeling cold all the time 
 Fainting, sleep problems, feeling dizziness all the time 
 Difficulty in concentrating 
 Poor immune system 
 Thinning of hair on head
sections.diagnosis_of_anorexia_nervosa:
If the below situation is observed in an individual, then it is said that a person may be suffering from this particular diseases. 
 Body weight or shape is experienced and if it is not normal, a person has chances that he/she is suffering from anorexia nervosa. 
 Dramatic weight loss. 
 A person restricts energy intake as required by the body.
